clue.text: Little time left in warm embrace is dear

indicators.note: being held in an embrace means being hugged inside, so the warm word wraps round the small pieces

blocks.note: T is the abbreviation for time; little signals the short form
L is the standard abbreviation for left
cosy means snug and warm

explanation.surface: A tender hug is said to be precious, with little time left together.
explanation.walkthrough: T and L sit inside COSY to make COS-TL-Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Dear in the sense of expensive is a synonym of costly.

clue.text: Not in union — albeit, oddly, in organisation allowing it

in places the jumbled letters inside the abbreviated organisation

explanation.surface: Someone unmarried who belongs, oddly, to a body that permits it.
explanation.walkthrough: The rearranged ALBEIT goes inside CE, the Church of England, which allows celibacy but does not require it of its priests.
explanation.definitionFit: Celibate describes someone abstaining from marriage, so not in a matrimonial union.

clue.text: Various changes, and person who delivers others

indicators.note: changes tells us the preceding word alters its letter order

blocks.note: the seven letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A rescuer who makes assorted changes to help people.
explanation.definitionFit: A saviour is a rescuer, one who delivers others from danger.

clue.text: Soft material that once formed cover for little jumper

blocks.clueFragment: once formed cover for little jumper
blocks.note: second meaning, read literally: the fleece that once coated a young sheep, a creature that leaps about

explanation.surface: A soft fabric once used to make a child's sweater.
explanation.walkthrough: Jumper is British for a pullover, but here it is a frisky young lamb whose fleece was its coat.
explanation.definitionFit: This fibre is a fine, soft wool shorn from young sheep, used for knitwear.

clue.text: Constituent is an ardent supporter

taken as written
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: Constituent looks like a voter, but here it means a component.
explanation.definitionFit: A partisan is a strong, often uncritical, adherent of a cause or party.

clue.text: A most unfriendly conclusion about possible site of leg injury

blocks.note: taken as written
the coldest manner is the least friendly
an end is a conclusion
on means about, as in a talk on a subject

explanation.surface: A frosty ending to a discussion of where someone hurt a leg.
explanation.definitionFit: The tendon joining calf muscle to heel is a common place for sports injuries to the lower leg.

clue.text: Article in no need of trimming? Good

blocks.note: someone thin has no need to slim down
G is the abbreviation for good

explanation.surface: A piece of writing that needs no cutting is called good.
explanation.walkthrough: Article suggests a newspaper piece needing no editing, but it is the definition, and trimming means losing weight.
explanation.definitionFit: An article in the sense of an object or item is simply a thing.

clue.text: Means of creating letters, say, clients reproduced

blocks.note: the seven letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A way of producing letters for customers, copied many times.
explanation.walkthrough: Letters suggests correspondence to clients, but means the shapes of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: A stencil is a cut-out template used to paint characters such as letters onto a surface.

clue.text: It's clear oddly deficient clues irritate

blocks.note: nett means clear, as in profit after deductions
the even letters of clues

explanation.surface: Clues that clearly fall short annoy the solver.
explanation.walkthrough: NETT is the British spelling of net, meaning clear after deductions.
explanation.definitionFit: To nettle someone is to annoy them, like the sting of the plant.

clue.text: Precious material pirate found under site of castle, we hear

blocks.note: Stirling in Scotland is famed for its castle
Long John Silver is the pirate of Treasure Island

explanation.surface: A buccaneer finds treasure buried beneath a castle.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, under puts the pirate after the castle town.
explanation.definitionFit: This alloy of 92.5 per cent silver is the standard precious metal for fine cutlery and jewellery.

clue.text: Nothing in court contest producing true partnership

blocks.note: love is zero in tennis, played on a court
a match is a contest

explanation.surface: A goalless tennis match leads to a real romance.
explanation.definitionFit: A love match is a marriage made for affection rather than money or status.

clue.text: Lacking skill in Italian holding writer back

indicators.note: back means the writing tool is read in the opposite direction
holding means the abbreviation wraps around the other piece

blocks.note: IT is a short form of Italian
a pen is a writing implement

explanation.surface: An unskilled Italian keeps restraining an author.
explanation.walkthrough: The writer is an implement, not a person.
explanation.definitionFit: Inept is a synonym of clumsy or incompetent.

clue.text: Tanker installing right navigational aid on computer

indicators.note: installing means placing something inside, so one letter goes into the tanker word

blocks.note: a bowser is a fuel or water tanker
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.walkthrough: A bowser is a British term for a tanker lorry carrying fuel or water; R goes in after the B.
explanation.definitionFit: A web browser is the program used to find one's way around the internet.

clue.text: American serving in pub using premises correctly, for example

indicators.note: in places the soldier inside the word for the pub

blocks.note: a GI is an American serviceman
one's local is one's regular pub in British usage

explanation.surface: An American soldier drinking in a bar keeps to the licensing rules.
explanation.walkthrough: Premises looks like the pub building, but it means the propositions of an argument. In Britain, your local is the pub you regularly drink at.
explanation.definitionFit: Reasoning that draws valid conclusions from its premises is logical; that is one example of the quality.

clue.text: Temperature, approximately, in part of body

blocks.note: T is the abbreviation for temperature
or so means roughly

explanation.surface: Roughly what temperature it is in some region of the body.
explanation.definitionFit: The torso is the trunk of the human body, without head or limbs.

clue.text: Namely, swallowing blend I mixed that's bad for consumer

swallowing means taking the other letters inside

blocks.note: i.e. is the Latin abbreviation for namely
the letters to be rearranged

explanation.definitionFit: Inedible food is unfit to eat, so bad for whoever consumes it.

clue.text: Popular rising still without courage or honour

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the word is read upwards, backwards
without in its old sense of outside, so this word surrounds the other

blocks.note: in means fashionable or popular
yet means still, as in not yet done

explanation.surface: A popular uprising lacking bravery or principle.
explanation.walkthrough: Without here means outside, not lacking. YET reversed gives TEY, and it surrounds GRIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Integrity is moral uprightness, a sense of honour and honesty.

clue.text: Communist's taken over country, in other words

blocks.note: a Red is a communist; the 's is short for has
a state is a country

explanation.surface: A communist has seized power in a nation.
explanation.walkthrough: Communist's means communist has, so the Red takes over STATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Restated means expressed again, put another way in different phrasing.

clue.text: Origin of glow, a small lamp

definitions.text: Origin of glow, a small lamp

indicators.note: the origin of a word is its starting point, so only its first letter is used

blocks.note: first letter of glow
taken as written
S is the abbreviation for small
a light is a lamp

explanation.surface: A little lamp is the source of a soft glow.
explanation.walkthrough: Read whole, the clue also describes the answer: a gas lamp that is a source of glow.
explanation.definitionFit: A gaslight is a lamp burning gas, a small source of glowing illumination.

clue.text: In brief, part of speech is edited as suggested

blocks.note: adv. is the short form of adverb
taken as written
ed. is the abbreviation for edited

explanation.surface: Part of a speech has been edited, as someone recommended.
explanation.walkthrough: Part of speech looks like a section of an address, but it is the grammar term, here adverb.
explanation.definitionFit: Advised means recommended, as in a course of action that was suggested.

clue.text: What left and right have in common with moderate guy

blocks.clueFragment: What left and right have in common
blocks.note: the only letter found in both words
to ease is to lessen or moderate

explanation.surface: Political left and right share common ground with a middle-of-the-road man.
explanation.walkthrough: Guy looks like a man, but is a verb meaning to mock. Left and right share only one letter, T.
explanation.definitionFit: To guy someone is to make fun of them, which is to tease.

clue.text: Artist upset about revolutionary elite creating studio

indicators.note: revolutionary suggests overturning order, so the letters are rearranged
in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so read backwards
about means around, so the reversed artist surrounds the other letters

blocks.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: An artist is angered by a radical elite forming an art workshop.
explanation.walkthrough: RA, a member of the Royal Academy, is the usual crossword artist.
explanation.definitionFit: An atelier is an artist's or designer's workshop, the French word for studio.

clue.text: In charge of party, be excessively active

blocks.note: to be over something is to be in charge of it
a do is a party

explanation.surface: Someone running a party goes too far.
explanation.definitionFit: To overdo it is to exert oneself too much, going beyond the sensible limit.

clue.text: Composer of the year as represented in pieces

definitions.text: Composer of the year as represented in pieces

blocks.clueFragment: the year as represented in pieces

blocks.clueFragment: Composer of the year as represented in pieces
blocks.note: setter's reading: the writer of musical pieces portraying the year's quarters, The Four Seasons

explanation.walkthrough: Pieces are musical works, and the year in four parts is The Four Seasons.

clue.text: Initially lacking merit, succeed as student

blocks.note: first letter of lacking
to earn is to merit

clue.text: Performer who needs to take a bow before starting
